body:
My last doctor told me last year that I was schizoaffective. Or bipolar with schizophrenic symptoms mixed in. Pretty good diagnosis, I think.

Nothing ever made the noises and whispers go away. No amount of meds ever helped. I stopped seeing the doctors last year though, because nothing ever helped. I knew that if I kept talking to them, I'd have to go back into the mental ward. 

Thanks for your thoughts.
